tasks.goal: Implement the accepted public invocation law including prerequisite effects.
steps: Classify selected operations by declared product-source effects and distinguish evidence-producing observers.

positive_cases: Build compiles and verify observes/retests completed production without creating source.

Old inclusive behavior cannot survive as a hidden ordinary-verify branch.

tasks.title: Define fixed full-pass composition and identity carriers
tasks.goal: Give users one explicit create-to-verify entry without adding a workflow engine.
steps: Define change apply as one explicit production operation followed by current-source verification.
Map invocation, production request, selected work, resolution, declaration, target and operation IDs across all carriers before implementation.
Specify park/resume/failure stopping points; verification failure never selects repair or another work item.
positive_cases: One exact full-pass request can park once and continue to verification.
negative_cases: Failed verification does not retry production or walk the work graph.
Changing invocation from create to verify alone does not change producer identity.
